subject: Midterm This Friday: Be There by 7:00 PM, Attendance Is Mandatory: DSS5105 Data Science Projects in Practice [2610]
body_text:
Dear Students,

The midterm is this Friday, and you've been preparing for it since the scope came out. Here is everything you need in one place.

Attendance is mandatory
Friday, 2 October 2026 (Week 7), LT29 — be seated by 7:00 PM

We will take attendance at 7:00 PM, and the exam runs 7:15 PM – 8:45 PM. Attendance is mandatory: if you are not present, you will receive zero marks for the midterm.

An absence is considered only in exceptional circumstances, and only if you inform [姓名] and me before the exam and provide official supporting documents (for example, a medical certificate). Without both, the midterm is marked zero.

* Format: 1.5 hours, MCQ only, on Examplify.
* Laptop: bring it fully charged, with its charger.
* Cheat sheet: one A4 sheet, two-sided, which you submit after the exam. Please write your [姓名] and [学号] on the cheat sheet before the exam starts.
* Download the paper beforehand: DSS5105 2610 Midterm is available in Examplify from 6:00 AM on Friday, 2 October 2026. The password will be announced in class.
* Scope: Week 0 → Midterm → Midterm_Scope.pdf lists exactly what is examinable.
* Mock exam: if you haven't run it yet, do it tonight on the laptop you will bring: DSS5105 2610 Midterm (Mock), password [密码].

After 8:45 PM, the remaining time is set aside for team project discussion.

subject: Mid-term on Wednesday September 30: DSS5102 Advanced Regression and Time Series Analysis [2610]
body_text:
Dear All,

This is an announcement about your mid-term exam on Wednesday September 30 in LT11 (the first week after the break). This is a fairly long message but please read all of it carefully.

You will be able to download the exam from 9am on the day of the exam. Please download the paper before you come to the exam venue. I will give you the password when it is time to start the exam.

You should have either attended the briefing by IT in the week 5 lecture about using the examplify software, or watched the webcast of the briefing. You should also have downloaded the briefing slides, downloaded examplify and done the things you were asked to do in the briefing to check your system. If you don't have access to a laptop that meets the system requirements to run examplify, then please contact me as soon as possible and I will arrange a loaner laptop.

1. The exam is open book, closed internet. This is a secure exam, and you cannot access any digital notes. You can bring in whatever physical notes you want.
2. The venue for the exam is LT11 (our normal lecture venue). The exam will start at 7pm and finish at 8pm.
3. You should try to arrive by 6.40pm at the latest.
4. I will be sending a seating plan before the exam. [...] Please don't forget to bring your charger.
5. The exam consists of 40 questions. 20 questions are multiple choice (4 options), and 20 are true or false.
6. Please don't forget to bring your student card for identification purposes.

Best,
[姓名]
